Section 1. [+PILLSBURY UNITED COMMUNITIES; APPROPRIATION. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Pillsbury United Communities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. PILLSBURY UNITED COMMUNITIES; APPROPRIATION.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Pillsbury United Communities to provide job training and workforce development services for individuals who are unemployed or underemployed. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Pillsbury United Communities to provide job training and workforce development services for individuals who are unemployed or underemployed. This is a onetime appropriation.
